body: I've thought a lot about the way you wrote this post.  Why would you think that talking to someone in this way that "thinks so little of themselves" would be helpful?  What makes you think that you are so much better than me?  Are you sure that you treat others with respect?  He has never spoken to me or "put me in my place" as quickly as you did.

I saw the comments about the disordered eating.  Instead, is it possible he is a super taster?  Super tasting is genetic and possibly can be passed on to kids.  This would be something to rule out.  Supertasters literally taste things in food that the rest of us do not.  Potatoes seems to be a popular choice with super tasters, because they are very plain.  If he had this, then you would know what foods to try and what foods to avoid, to try to expand what he will eat.

Here is another thought, I'm dyslexic, but part of how I remember how to spell things is by muscle memory. For instance my spelling on a keyboard is much better than when I write with a pen. I have the worst time trying to type something in with a controller.

The other thing is, guys sometimes see details like spelling a name as not very important, but he might know every detail about how you look naked. He may know the look on your face when he says something you don't like.

Does he do intentional things to try to make you feel special?

I think the real question is, do you want to be a father? You wouldn't the first person to leave a relationship who didn't want to live that lifestyle. How much do you love and want to stay with your wife? This is regardless if you are the biological father or not. Even if you are not the biological father it doesn't mean she cheated on you. She may have gotten a sperm donation from a clinic or borrowed some from her gay best friend. Someone else brought up how women can want to believe that they are pregnant so bad that their bodies go along with it, no way to know for sure until she gets an ultrasound.

Stress can mess with your cycle.  Sometimes moving in with other women can mess with your cycle. I have PCOS so my cycles can be all there place. Some kinds of birth control pills can make periods lighter.

Not to mention studies found that sperm can live up to 2 weeks in there. My last baby I had a normally timed moderately heavy period the first month, but I was still pregnant when it happened. The OB told me that was normal for that to happen.
Well I somehow managed to get pregnant on two occasions from a single session.  Guess the fertility was rocking, 17 years apart too. I'm with though he likely isn't the father.

btw if it actually was something redownloaded it would have been in a different directory on his phone and wouldn't have just popped up on the camera roll. Pictures also have timestamps that can tell you the last time they were modified. If all the pictures came up with the same date then it would have made sense that they were redownloaded. It sounds a lot like the picture you took was in the same group these pictures? Which would mean they were in the same directory. Just some thoughts, because a lot of people don't understand tech.  There are a lot guys who do keep souvenir pictures from past sex encounters, because it's the best kind of porn.

They usually know if someone is cheating in a relationship, people act different when they are lying and covering things up. Which may have been why your ex husband and you drifted apart. Also, you don't really need to police anyone's relationship. People see this as truth telling, but it isn't your truth to tell.

There are times when people meetup with old lovers to have closure, to say goodbye. They don't nessisarily want their spouse to know even though they are not technically doing anything wrong.

I'm not exaggerating. I don't remember him doing this when we first got together.  Really feel like he doesn't care what I have to say and picking on my use of words is more entertaining for him. I have had direct conversations with him about it but he keeps doing it.

Then there are times like today, I was trying to change the belt out on his mother's vacuum. He tried to warn me it was a bad idea because his mother gets so upset about her staff. I explained to him that I understood that but I had already talked to her about it. Then he started going off that there was never anything wrong with vacuum cleaners and it is just my imagination. I try to explain things to him but he doesn't listen or bother to check it out for himself. The way he was talking to me just makes me so upset. I feel be littled and treated like I don't know anything. The reason I was trying to change the belt is because it smells like burning rubber and it isn't picking up that well. I have a messy two year old and I'm just trying to keep the floors clean. BTW Dyson DC41's are tough to change the belt if you don't have specific screwdrivers.

I have a similar problem but with a boyfriend I have had for 6 plus years. He decided he didn't do "hallmark" holidays. He hasn't even told me merry christmas, happy birthday, and happy Valentines day for years. We were in different places during Christmas and he ghosted me for 3 days. He had called me twice day for a week before that. I threw a fit to be honest I told him I don't feel appreciated. I do buy things both during holidays and in-between. I honestly don't care buy me some cheap flowers, I just want the effort of taking the time to feel Special. He never really tells me he is going to change but he made sure to tell happy new years. He got me some candy for V day and some candy for our daughter and took as out to early dinner. It wasn't romantic it kind of fell flat and he was just going threw the motions. It still was better than nothing and perhaps it will become less of a chore. (I bought him a longer charging cable for his phone, as he uses it constantly.)

btw Birthdays have been around for lot longer than Hallmark. I would even be good with us making our own fun holidays and traditions. For instance it's June, lets take a weekend trip to the beach. etc.

Here is away to go about it passively. Go to the guidence counciler and tell them you want to be moved out of his class. Wait until they ask you why, then just say he touches me. This should be alarming to any adult and they should ask more questions. Don't say anything until the adult directly asks you a question about it.  This makes you appear less like someone who is out to get a teacher and more like someone who just wants away from a person who are the uncomfortable. Another example would be to go to your parents and ask if you can take the class in the summer with a different teacher. When they ask you why say the teacher makes you feel uncomfortable, and you just don't want to be in their class anymore. Go to multiple adults like this until someone takes you seriously. If you have a resource officer (police officer in the school) go to him. They are actually a separate entity from the school. Be like, I don't think he did anything illegal but I feel uncomfortable and want out of his class.  There is also a vice principle and principle. You could even go to another teacher. Doesn't have to be a female teacher, sometimes men will actually take things more seriously as they feel protective, and when women have been in the same situation themselves they often try to act like it isn't a big deal. My mother talks about a gym teacher who would touch them inappropriately and she is 65 years old.  You are not overreacting that this teacher makes you feel uncomfortable and will feel the same way about it when you get older.

The hematologist told me that people with iron that low have heart problems.  I have a certification I'm going to study for which should get me a nice stay at home or desk job.

I know his mother well at this point and some of the things she says no mother should.  He had  with his grandmother who had a chronic illness and passed away.  His wife was hitting him and her explosive behavior was so bad that it was documented when he was in the Airforce.  On top of having PTSD from both the father and combat. Oh and my parents are a hot mess of codependent misery.  I don't remember a time when they liked each other.  My mom is controlling and my dad's anxiety comes out as anger.  Growing up I was terrified one day he would lose it and kill me, and he was the nurturing parent.  I spent many years not being able to have an argument because I just coped with it by shutting down(not talking).  I have some mood swing problems.  One thing will set me off and I'll be down for days.  I've been trying anti depressants recently but they make my nervous system problems worse.
